products.title: The Ultimate Caddy Towel - White + Red Stripe
products.body_html:
We've crafted the ultimate golf towel for every player, featuring a built-in scrub pad for effortless club cleaning.

Sized at 44" × 22" for convenient cleaning and easy carry. 

What sets it apart:

  1. Tour-size: Large enough to cover your clubs in rain, dew, or dust while still hanging cleanly on your bag.
  2. Built-in brush pad: Integrated non-abrasive scrub pad for quick, efficient groove cleaning — no separate accessory, no hassle.
  3. Designed for golf, not laundry: Textured weave lifts dirt and moisture instead of smearing it around.

This isn’t just another rag. It’s a towel designed with the details of the game in mind. Whether you’re walking 18 or grinding through practice, the Ultimate Caddy Towel makes sure your equipment stays as ready as you are.

products.title: Magnet Towel - White
products.body_html:
The Magnet Towel rethinks one of the most-used pieces of gear in your bag. With a powerful built-in magnet, it stays exactly where you need it—on your cart, your clubs, or any metal surface—so cleaning up is always within reach.

The Magnetic Towel combines premium microfiber performance with effortless accessibility, helping golfers spend less time searching for their towel and more time focused on the next shot.

What sets it apart:

Powerful magnetic attachment: Securely clips to carts, clubs, and other metal surfaces for quick access throughout the round.

Premium microfiber construction: Soft, absorbent fabric lifts away moisture, dirt, and debris without scratching club finishes.

Always within reach: No more bending down or digging through your bag. Attach it where you need it and grab it instantly.

Built for the course: Durable materials and reinforced construction stand up to rain, dew, mud, and long days on the links.

Clean clubs, better contact: Keep grooves and clubfaces free of debris so every shot performs the way it should.

This isn't just another golf towel. It's a smarter way to keep your equipment clean and your routine efficient. From the first tee to the final putt, the Magnetic Towel stays close, works hard, and helps you stay focused on the game.
